svg.title: Announcing Waffuru
svg.desc: Share card for the post Announcing Waffuru. Headline: More intelligence on hardware you already own. Below it: the AI stack that runs on hardware you own or rent, plus Pantry, free, out today. Under the subtext, the label runs open models from, and white logos for Qwen, Meta, NVIDIA, DeepSeek, GLM, Liquid AI and Google Gemma. On the right, the stack inside a dashed boundary labelled hardware you own or rent: you, your team and your agents at the top, then six layers, each with its icon: Security (Pantry, outlined in gold as the product being announced), Agents (Waffle), Memory (Whisk), Control (Syrup), Engine (Butter) and Kernels (Iron), above Apple silicon, NVIDIA and AMD. The waffle mark and waffuru.ai sit bottom left.
svg.text: The AI stack that runs on hardware you own
or rent. Plus Pantry, free, out today.
